title: s500-literature-83: Example intracranial EEG with qHFO detections from 'Redaction of false High Frequency Oscillations due to muscle artifact' (Stacey lab, Mendeley Data)
description: An example intracranial EEG recording from a single epilepsy monitoring patient, comprising 61 channels sampled at 5000 Hz for 10 minutes, together with 357 automated qHFO (quasi high-frequency oscillation) detections. The data were released with the code of Ren et al. (2019) to demonstrate a wavelet-entropy feature that separates EMG-contaminated false HFOs from true HFOs. Recordings are converted to BrainVision format, and detections are provided as BIDS events.
methods_description: The source int16 intracranial matrix (61 x 3000001, 5000 Hz) was converted to BrainVision IEEE float32 with values unchanged. Automated qHFO detections (start/stop sample and channel) were converted to events.tsv. No channel names, electrode positions, reference or units were provided in the original release.
